description: For each trader type, count the distinct transactions that have at least one advanced behaviour analysis and a matching trader. Report that count and its share of the total count over all trader types.

a.request: Considering only advanced behaviour analyses whose linked transaction record and trader both exist, for each trader type (`tradekind`) give the trader type, the number of distinct transactions analysed (a transaction analysed twice counts once), and that number divided by the total of these numbers over all trader types, without rounding.
a.sql:
WITH trader_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    t.tradekind,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ab.translink) as distinct_transactions
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
)
SELECT 
  tradekind,
  distinct_transactions,
  distinct_transactions::numeric / (SELECT SUM(distinct_transactions) FROM trader_counts) as proportion
FROM trader_counts
ORDER BY tradekind;

d.request: For each trader type, count the distinct transactions with an advanced behaviour analysis that also have a valid trader, reporting count and unrounded share of the total transaction count across all trader types.
d.sql:
WITH transaction_analysis AS (
  SELECT 
    t.tradekind,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) as transaction_count
  FROM transactionrecord tr
  JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  JOIN advancedbehavior ab ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
),
total_count AS (
  SELECT SUM(transaction_count) as total FROM transaction_analysis
)
SELECT 
  ta.tradekind,
  ta.transaction_count,
  ta.transaction_count::NUMERIC / tc.total as share
FROM transaction_analysis ta
CROSS JOIN total_count tc
ORDER BY ta.tradekind;

c.request: For each trader type, how many analysed trade records are there in the advanced behaviour data (only where the trade and its trader can be found), and what share of the overall total does each type make up? Keep the share unrounded. For each trader type, count the distinct transactions that have at least one advanced behaviour analysis and a matching trader. Report that count and its share of the total count over all trader types.
c.sql: WITH trade_counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) as count FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), total AS (SELECT SUM(count) as total_count FROM trade_counts) SELECT tc.tradekind, tc.count, tc.count::NUMERIC / t.total_count as share FROM trade_counts tc, total t ORDER BY tc.tradekind;

b.request: For each trader type, count the distinct transactions that have at least one advanced behaviour analysis and a matching trader, reporting the count and its unrounded share of the total count across all trader types.
b.sql: WITH transaction_counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) as transaction_count FROM trader t INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref INNER JOIN advancedbehavior ab ON tr.transreg = ab.translink GROUP BY t.tradekind), total_transactions AS (SELECT SUM(transaction_count) as total FROM transaction_counts) SELECT tc.tradekind, tc.transaction_count, CAST(tc.transaction_count AS FLOAT) / tt.total as share FROM transaction_counts tc CROSS JOIN total_transactions tt ORDER BY tc.tradekind
b.raw: For each trader type, count the distinct transactions that have at least one advanced behaviour analysis and a matching trader, reporting the count and its unrounded share of the total count across all trader types.
